question.text: The purpose of FEMA was to:

answer.text: Facilitate external trade and payments and maintain orderly development of the forex market in India

explanation.text: The Logic: FEMA aims to facilitate (not restrict) external trade, promote orderly forex market development, and utilize foreign exchange resources efficiently. It replaced the more restrictive FERA. The Trap: FEMA FACILITATES forex activities; FERA was the restrictive predecessor. Cross-Exam Context: FEMA objectives are tested in Series I.
